release_notes: A new **STOCKTAKE** mode next to SELL / STOCK IN / STOCK OUT / SET COUNT: scan or search items one after another to count what's on the shelf — every scan of the same item adds +1 (or use the − / + row controls for bulk). The sheet shows each item's **counted vs system stock with a colored difference** (green = matches, red = missing, amber = surplus), a live summary, and a **Re-check stock** button that refreshes the system numbers if another PC sold something mid-count. **Commit differences** adjusts only the items that differ — every change logged in the Activity Log, and one **Ctrl+Z** undoes the whole stocktake.; The part-type filter chips could still be clipped: the row was a fixed-height scroll strip and any overflow squeezed the chips. The chips now **wrap onto additional lines** instead of scrolling — every chip is always fully visible and tappable, with no scrollbar at all.
